feed.title: Google Cloud: Apigee Edge for Public Cloud
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Apigee Edge for Public Cloud

entry.content:
Scheduled maintenance of Management/Control Plane for the Apigee Edge for Public Cloud on November 6, 2026.

Scheduled maintenance of Management/Control Plane for the Apigee Edge for Public Cloud production will take place on Friday, November 6, 2026, from 9:00 PM PT to 10:00 PM PT (Saturday, November 7, 2026, from 5:00 AM UTC to 6:00 AM UTC). This maintenance follows the monthly maintenance window schedule documented in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.

During the scheduled maintenance window, the following services will be temporarily unavailable, and attempts to access them will return a 4xx status code:

  • Management Services UI
  • Management Services APIs
  • Monetization Management APIs
  • New proxy deployments
  • DevPortal Service
  • Microgateway Services
  • Edge Query (Analytics Stats APIs)

Runtime API calls to deployed API proxies are unaffected. While access to analytics queries may be temporarily unavailable during the maintenance window, all analytics and metrics data from this period will be available once maintenance ends.
entry.summary: Scheduled maintenance for the Apigee Edge for Public Cloud Management/Control Plane will occur on November 6, 2026, from 9:00 PM to 10:00 PM PT. During this time, management services and APIs will be temporarily unavailable, though runtime API calls will not be affected.
entry.title: Announcement: Apigee Edge Maintenance November 6

entry.content: On October 15, 2026, we began releasing Single Sign-On (SSO) updates for Apigee Edge for Public Cloud.
entry.summary: Starting October 15, 2026, Apigee Edge for Public Cloud will receive Single Sign-On (SSO) updates. These updates are designed to enhance the security and user experience of accessing your APIs.
entry.title: Announcement: SSO Updates for Apigee Edge

entry.content: | Bug ID | Component | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | 560310696 | SSO | Fixed an issue where the Portal SSO endpoint inadvertently accepted deprecated TLS 1.1 connections. The endpoint now strictly enforces TLS 1.2+. |
entry.summary: The Portal SSO endpoint has been updated to resolve a security vulnerability. It now strictly enforces TLS 1.2+ connections, preventing the acceptance of deprecated TLS 1.1.
entry.title: Fixed: SSO TLS Security Improved

entry.content:
Security fixes for the integrated portal and API specs in the Apigee Edge management UIs.

The Apigee Edge UIs for managing integrated portals and API specs were updated to patch vulnerabilities in underlying libraries and serving components. Functionality is unchanged, but some pages might show minor styling differences.
entry.summary: Security vulnerabilities in the Apigee Edge integrated portal and API specs UIs have been patched. These updates address underlying library and serving component issues. Functionality remains the same, though minor styling changes may occur.
entry.title: Security: Security updates for Apigee Edge UIs

entry.content:
Apigee Edge for Public Cloud release notes are now published on Google Cloud documentation.

Release notes for Apigee Edge for Public Cloud, including its Edge UI, SSO, Message Processor, and integrated portal components, are published on the Apigee Edge for Public Cloud release notes page from September 2026 onward. You can subscribe to that page with a feed reader to be notified when a new release is published.

Release notes published before September 2026 remain available in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.
entry.summary: Release notes for Apigee Edge for Public Cloud, covering its various components, are now available on the Google Cloud documentation site starting from September 2026. Previous release notes are accessible in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.
entry.title: Announcement: Apigee Edge Release Notes Now on Google Cloud Docs
